title: Will and Inheritance
author: Freya Delacroix
blurb: Ulyana Coldharbour, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
